payload.core_composition_summary: Sort suffix sums, then greedily pick the largest k-1 to add to total sum for maximum cost.
payload.rationale: The solution computes suffix sums, sorts them, and takes the top k-1 to add to the total sum. Sorting orders the candidates, then greedy selection picks the best.
